content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Director-General position at the World Health Organization. Tell about your experience in public health promotion, pandemic management, and health system development. Describe your vision for reforming WHO and its role in global health security. Also reflect on how you would strengthen health equity globally. Length about 450 words.
